You are a deer trapped in a foggy and dark hedge maze.
Use WASD to navigate the maze.

Ten strawberries are scattered around the maze.
Collect all the strawberries to win.
There will be bears roaming around the maze too - avoid getting caught by them!

Choose a difficulty to start the game.
